answer: Sybil resistance here rests on proof-of-attendance record across twenty check-ins verified by on-chain log entries. Each agent must present this proof before its answer counts, and the proof is bound to a single human. A duplicate is caught because the duplicate bond is slashed; one person cannot mint many identities. The log keeps a nebula for each honest agent, a shale for the network, and a zenith that marks verified work.
